established: The reported ablation removes predictor and directly aligns online and momentum representations while observing the reconstruction curve. Current published entrypoint exposes only loss-A, normalization and skip switches, never a no-predictor switch.
exact_unresolved: Online encoder under mask_x emits only visible time slots; momentum encoder normally emits all time slots. Original no-predictor alignment indexing and denominator are not specified.
Reconstructor API supports visible-only mask_x, but neither paper nor released run specifies whether this branch or full-time placeholder completion was used.
Original ablation variant/seed/parent multiplicity and recorded curve step support are not provided by Figure6.
implementation_decision: Do not replace unconditional original-identity refusal with a guessed ablation or claim historical completeness. Continue all independent implementable EEGNet/Temple source operations.
possible_reconstruction_not_selected: Direct visible-time target gather and visible-only reconstructor input is mechanically supported by retained APIs, but not uniquely established as the original experiment. Other masked-slot completion choices alter the loss and gradient.

public_primary.access: Official primary read through web tool; no primary body copied into R or any proposal
